clue.text: King having a great time — a blast!

parts.note: K is the chess and card abbreviation for king
a boom is a period of prosperity, a great time for business

explanation.surface: A monarch enjoying himself enormously declares it all a blast.
explanation.definitionFit: The exclamation imitates the sound of an explosion, so it stands for a blast.

clue.text: A weirdo, whichever way you look at it

indicators.text: whichever way you look at it
indicators.note: reading it from either end gives the same letters, so the word is a palindrome

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Someone odd is odd from every angle.
explanation.definitionFit: A kook is slang for an eccentric or crazy person, a weirdo.

clue.text: Where boredom unusual (if you're lucky!)

indicators.note: something unusual is out of the ordinary, so these letters are set in a different order

explanation.surface: A cheeky aside about where tedium is, with luck, rare.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition: with luck, the room where you sleep with a partner is not a place of tedium.
explanation.definitionFit: The room for sleeping and intimacy is, if you're lucky, a place where tedium is rare.

clue.text: Great work, as old relation steals gold

indicators.note: one piece takes the other into itself, as a thief takes loot inside

parts.note: a ratio is a mathematical relation between quantities
OR is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: A family member pockets gold, framed as a grand classical piece.
explanation.definitionFit: An oratorio is a large-scale choral composition, a great musical work such as Handel's Messiah.

clue.text: Slight tease, bit of a porker

parts.note: spare can mean lean or thin, slight in build
to rib someone is to tease them

explanation.surface: Gentle mockery of someone a little overweight.
explanation.definitionFit: A spare rib is a cut of pork, so literally a piece of a pig.

clue.text: See 21
So you don't say?

definitions.meaning: as an intensifier, so good means very good, truly good
an exclamation of surprise or mild disbelief at news

explanation.definitionFit: The word works as an intensifying adverb like 'so' and as an incredulous exclamation like 'you don't say'.

clue.text: Might this comprise a candlelit dinner, then bloke caught fertilising eggs?

definitions.text: Might this comprise a candlelit dinner

indicators.note: the man and the catch get in among the eggs, as fertilisation enters the roe

parts.note: roe is a mass of fish eggs
a bloke is a man
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A romantic meal, then a strange image of a fellow fertilising fish eggs.
explanation.definitionFit: A candlelit dinner for two is a classic ingredient of courtship and love affairs.

clue.text: Where bolder explorer's heading — but there's a catch to it!

definitions.text: Where bolder explorer's heading — but there's a catch to it!

parts.note: brassier means bolder, more brazen

indicators.note: the heading of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A daring adventurer sets off, but there is a snag in the plan.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as a whole the clue describes a bra: the bolder 'explorer' heads there, and it has a catch, the hook fastening.
explanation.definitionFit: A bra fastens with a hook, a catch, and is where a bold hand might wander.

clue.text: Greater Manchester's creaking joint?

parts.note: something creaking is aged, old
a ham is a joint of meat

explanation.surface: Asking whether a creaky knee belongs to the north-west of England.
explanation.definitionFit: Oldham is a large town within Greater Manchester, so it is one of the county's places.

clue.text: Send back perfect lamb, perhaps, having eaten beef to get blood poisoning

indicators.note: one piece has taken the other inside it, as food is swallowed
sending back means reading the words from the end to the start

parts.note: A1 means first-class, perfect, written here as AI
lamb is an example of meat
beef comes from an ox

explanation.surface: A diner returns flawless lamb after eating beef and gets food poisoning.
explanation.walkthrough: The reversal reads TAEMIA, and the beef goes in right after its first letter; A1, written AI, is the old Lloyd's Register mark for first-class.
explanation.definitionFit: Toxaemia is the presence of toxins in the bloodstream, a form of blood poisoning.

clue.text: When touring, miss London (also Pacific nation)

indicators.note: touring means going round, so these letters are moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: A traveller abroad pines for the capital while visiting the Pacific.
explanation.definitionFit: The archipelago east of Papua New Guinea is an independent country in the South Pacific.

clue.text: Frank said to appear surprised

parts.note: open means frank, candid
mouthed means said, voiced

explanation.surface: Someone named Frank is reported to look astonished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frank' looks like a man's name but means candid.
explanation.definitionFit: Gaping with the jaw dropped is the look of someone astonished.

clue.text: Siren's given Fury stick, the sucker!

parts.note: a siren is a seductive woman, a vamp
fury means ire, rage
a bat is a stick used in cricket or baseball

explanation.surface: A temptress is handed a rod by an avenging Fury: what a mug!
explanation.definitionFit: This South American creature feeds on blood by sucking it, so it is literally a sucker.

clue.text: Holding pose, possible can be seen

indicators.note: one piece holds the other inside it

parts.note: viable means possible, workable
to sit is to pose for a portrait

explanation.surface: A model holds a pose, possibly where everyone can see.
explanation.definitionFit: Something open to visitors is able to be seen or visited.

clue.text: Water, pure and simple

definitions.meaning: a lake or pond, a body of water

explanation.definitionFit: The noun is a poetic word for a lake, and the adjective means no more than or sheer.

clue.text: To get the better of folk, aunt proves devious

indicators.note: devious means winding and crooked, so these letters take a twisted new order

explanation.surface: A scheming relative outwits the family.
explanation.definitionFit: To go round an opponent's side is to outmanoeuvre, outdo them.

clue.text: Wasteful scum in 21 5

indicators.note: this light's answer, the return of the, signals that the run is read backwards
the answer lies within the letters of the other light

parts.note: the cross-reference to the other light's answer, the parable's title figure

explanation.surface: Contempt for the wasteful son of the parable, scum in the story.
explanation.walkthrough: The cross-reference does double duty in the surface: 21 reads 'the return of the', a reversal signal, before 5's letters, where GALS turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: Slag is the waste scum skimmed off molten metal in smelting.

clue.text: Flower's somewhat phenomenal ascent

indicators.note: in a down clue, going up means reading from bottom to top
only part of the word is taken, a run of letters within it

explanation.surface: A bloom shoots up remarkably fast.
explanation.definitionFit: The anemone, or windflower, is a garden flower of the buttercup family.

clue.text: Weaken, having torn a muscle at end of game

indicators.note: torn means ripped apart, so these letters are pulled into a new order
the end of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A player is laid low by a muscle tear late in the match.
explanation.definitionFit: To castrate a man is the literal sense; figuratively it means to deprive of strength.

clue.text: What's different: skill to get across

indicators.note: made different means rearranged into a new order

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written
art means skill, as in the art of persuasion

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about how talent can get its point over.
explanation.definitionFit: The old preposition means from side to side, crosswise, so across.

clue.text: Poker may be very exciting

definitions.meaning: a ... poker is a tall flowering plant, and a poker heated in the fire glows
thrilling, sensational, as in hot news

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both the plant kniphofia's common name and slang for extremely exciting.

clue.text: Dubious other painter shouldn't forge Rembrandt's work

indicators.note: something dubious is questionable, not straight, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A shady artist should not fake an Old Master.
explanation.definitionFit: This late Rembrandt painting shows the wayward son of the parable kneeling before his father.

clue.text: Girl with a lisp? An unlikely story

indicators.note: a lisp turns the hissing sound into a soft th, so the word is pronounced differently

parts.note: miss is a word for a girl

explanation.surface: A young woman who lisps tells a tall tale.
explanation.walkthrough: Said with a lisp, MISS becomes 'mith', which sounds like MYTH.
explanation.definitionFit: A myth is a widely believed but false tale, an unlikely story.

clue.text: Relation attending university that was a joke, creating uproar

parts.note: bro is short for brother, a relation
ha ha is the response to a joke

explanation.surface: A brother at college laughs at a joke, causing a commotion.
explanation.definitionFit: A brouhaha is a noisy fuss or commotion, an uproar.

clue.text: Woman after reversal of morning sickness

indicators.note: the second piece comes after the first in the answer
a reversal means the letters are read backwards

parts.note: AM stands for ante meridiem, the morning
a lady is a woman

explanation.surface: A woman suffering from morning sickness.
explanation.definitionFit: A malady is an illness or disease, a sickness.

clue.text: Light now failing, happening before team loses opener

parts.note: an event is a happening

indicators.note: the team loses its opening letter, the first one dropped

parts.note: a side is a team

explanation.surface: Dusk falls on a match where a team loses its opening batsman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loses opener' takes S from SIDE, leaving IDE; an 'opener' in cricket is an opening batsman, which suits the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Eventide is an old word for evening, the time when daylight fades.

clue.text: A few lines of comedy or artistry?

definitions.text: A few lines of comedy or artistry?

parts.words: A few lines of comedy or artistry?
parts.note: a short comic scene or a quick rough drawing made with a few strokes of the pencil

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a short humorous scene and a rough drawing of a few lines.
